name: Savitribai Phule Scholarship for Girl Students (Classes 5-10, Maharashtra)
benefit: Monthly scholarship to reduce dropout of backward-class girl students in Maharashtra schools: Rs 60 per month for 10 months (Rs 600/year) for girls in classes 5th to 7th, and Rs 100 per month for 10 months (Rs 1,000/year) for girls in classes 8th to 10th. Paid via DBT into an Aadhaar-seeded bank account, in two installments. The scheme runs as parallel variants for SC girls, OBC girls, and VJNT/SBC girls (each administered by its department).
eligibility_rules: Must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC), OBC, VJNT (Vimukta Jati Nomadic Tribes) or SBC (Special Backward Class) category, depending on the variant
Must be studying in classes 5th to 10th in a government or government-aided school in Maharashtra
Must be a resident of Maharashtra
There is NO income limit and NO minimum marks requirement

No individual application is needed - the school headmaster submits a consolidated list of eligible girls on the MahaDBT portal to the District Social Welfare Officer (classes 5-7) or Assistant Commissioner of Social Welfare (classes 8-10)
Attendance conditions apply: minimum attendance is required (60% for the second installment; some districts cite 75% overall)
exclusions: Girls in self-financed schools are not eligible (government and government-aided schools only)
A student who fails the year is not eligible until she passes that class
No benefit beyond 10 months per year; students enrolled mid-year are paid only for months attended
Girls not belonging to the covered categories (SC/OBC/VJNT/SBC) are not covered by this scheme
documents_required: Caste certificate / category proof (SC, OBC, VJNT or SBC)
Aadhaar card with Aadhaar-seeded bank account
School enrollment proof (handled by the school - the headmaster submits the consolidated proposal)
how_to_apply: No application needed from the student or parents. The school headmaster submits the list of eligible girl students online on the MahaDBT portal (mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in) - to the District Social Welfare Officer, Zilla Parishad for classes 5-7, or the Assistant Commissioner of Social Welfare for classes 8-10. Parents can contact the school headmaster or the district social welfare office to ensure their daughter is included.
source_document: Commissionerate of Social Welfare Maharashtra; SJSA Department; MahaDBT scheme pages; GRs dated 12/01/1996 and 25/07/2003
